label: Email
summary: Email built-in class and related message-sending behavior.
must_follow: Instantiate the built-in Email class with curly braces.
Look up exact recipient, attachment, CC, BCC, and ignore-error parameter behavior before sending.
Handle send failures explicitly when workflow state depends on email delivery.
avoid: Do not pass NIL or empty recipient arrays unless the documented function behavior accepts them.
Do not use CreateUdObject for Email.

elements.name: Email
elements.summary: Composes, loads, saves, sends, or queues email messages with attachments and optional signing or encryption.

elements.name: SendLimsEmail
elements.summary: Sends an email through SMTP and returns whether the send succeeded.
